research.koniava.research_basics.descrip: Nara has shared a method to record your findings. A Research Table lets you organize discoveries into knowledge.
research.koniava.mana_deployer.descripti: A conduit-powered dispenser that uses mana to project items with precision. The first step toward automated mana workflows.
research.koniava.mana_deployer.lore: It fires. It counts. It never gets tired.
research.koniava.mana_charger.descriptio: A dedicated machine that refills mana-powered items. Connect it to your conduit network and it handles the rest.
research.koniava.mana_charger.lore: Pour mana in. Get capability out. Efficient, if you keep the supply steady.
research.koniava.aspect_altar.descriptio: Resonance patterns in mana crystals can be amplified into a focal structure. The altar serves as a convergence point for aspect energies.
research.koniava.aspect_altar.lore: The readings spike near large crystal formations. Something is trying to organize.
research.koniava.altar_ring_upgrade.desc: The resonance rings surrounding the altar are not decoration. They are structured amplifiers that redistribute mana flow through the entire multiblock. This entry is a technical reference and does not unlock any equipment.
research.koniava.altar_ring_upgrade.lore: Each ring is a lens. Stack enough lenses and you stop magnifying — you start reshaping.
research.koniava.mana_weapons.descriptio: Directed mana discharge as a weapon. The floating turret is the first application: a self-stabilizing mana cannon that hovers beside the wielder.
research.koniava.mana_weapons.lore: It does not fire bullets. It fires decisions.

research.koniava.already_have_note: You already have a research note for: %s
nara.dialogue.tutorial.research_table.li: Oh! You found the research table! Knew you would.
Right, down to business. Research note in the left slot, ink quill in the right, then confirm and the puzzle starts.
The puzzle is simple: just connect the related aspect cells into a path. Path done, knowledge unlocked, that is it.
First pick a research from the watch knowledge tree and you will get that research note. Go try it, I am not babysitting you! Bye~
nara.dialogue.tutorial.first_scan.line1: First scan logged. Whatever you just scanned now has aspects on record. Those are data.
nara.dialogue.tutorial.first_scan.line2: Scan more things. Different materials, creatures, blocks. The knowledge tree grows as you discover. That is the whole point.
This is your knowledge tree. Each node is a piece of mana science you have not unlocked yet.
Scan things out in the world to collect their aspects, then meet the requirements shown here. That is how you progress.
There is also a guide tab in this watch. All machine hints and usage tips are there if you need them.
nara.dialogue.tutorial.mana_gen_craft.li: A Mana Generator. Good. Now it needs to go in the world.
Place it down somewhere solid. Once it is placed, I will show you the rest.
nara.dialogue.tutorial.mana_gen_placed.l: This is the generator control panel. Slot fuel into the center slot at the top to start burning.
The mana produced here needs somewhere to go. Connect arcane conduits to the output face and route them to your machines.
See that area on the left side of the GUI? Click it to look up valid fuels in JEI.
nara.dialogue.tutorial.wand_rod.craft.li: You made it! This is the Arcane Pulse Modulator, the core device for controlling all mana tools.
Just holding it won't do much though. Craft a core plugin and slot it in to unlock its real function.
nara.dialogue.tutorial.wand_rod.no_items: That is a wand rod. It needs a core before it can do anything. Upgrade modules help too.
Craft a core first. Once you have one, hold the rod and press [%s] (default: U) to open the upgrade screen.
nara.dialogue.tutorial.wand_rod.ready.li: You already have a core. Hold the wand rod and press [%s] (default: U). Top-left slot is the core, left side slots below are for upgrades.
nara.dialogue.tutorial.wand_rod.got_core: There it is. Hold the wand rod and press [%s] (default: U). Top-left slot takes the core, the left side slots below it take upgrades.
nara.dialogue.tutorial.first_research.li: First research complete. That knowledge is now yours.
Unlock more nodes in the watch. Each one opens something new. Keep going.
nara.dialogue.tutorial.first_altar_forme: The altar is formed. This structure channels raw mana into a usable form.
Place items on the pedestals, then activate the center. That is how altar crafting works.
nara.dialogue.tutorial.mana_grinder.line: Mana Grinder. Grinds materials into powders and crystals. Essential for mana crafting.
Put materials in the input slot and connect arcane conduits for mana. It handles the rest.
Open the grinder and click the book icon in the top right to look up grindable recipes in JEI.
nara.dialogue.tutorial.mana_infuser.line: Mana Infuser. Channels mana directly into items to produce enhanced materials.
Place materials in the input slot, supply mana via arcane conduits, and collect the output when done.
Open the infuser and click the book icon in the top right to browse infusion recipes in JEI.
nara.dialogue.tutorial.mana_crafting_cra: A Mana Crafting Table. Good. Now place it in the world.
Find a spot and place it down. The interface will open automatically.
nara.dialogue.tutorial.mana_crafting.lin: Mana Crafting Table. Crafts advanced recipes that a normal crafting table cannot handle.
Arrange materials in the grid, supply mana through conduits, and collect the output when it finishes.
Open the crafting table and click near the crafting grid to browse available mana recipes in JEI.
Aspect Synthesis. Combine two basic aspects here to produce more complex ones.
Drag aspects into the two input slots on the left. The result shows on the right. Each synthesis uses ink from the quill.
Click the highlighted area to look up all synthesis combinations in JEI.
nara.dialogue.tutorial.mana_deployer.lin: Mana Deployer. It automatically interacts with whatever is in front of it. Right-click mode uses or places items. Left-click mode breaks blocks.
Put items in the input slot, set the mode, then supply mana via arcane conduits. Adjust the facing side to change what it targets.
nara.dialogue.tutorial.mana_charger.line: Mana Charger. Dedicated to restoring mana in mana-powered items. Connect it to a conduit network and it runs on its own.
Put the item to charge in the charging slot and supply mana through arcane conduits. Collect it when full and slot in the next one.
nara.dialogue.tutorial.solar_collector.l: Solar mana collector. No fuel — just sunlight converted into mana. Sounds great, right? It stops working at night and in rain, but if you're tired of feeding machines, this one runs itself.
Place it somewhere with open sky, connect a conduit on the bottom face, and it pushes mana out automatically during the day. Upgrade slots take speed upgrades — no upgrades means base output only.
nara.dialogue.tutorial.boots_equip.line1: Oh, you put those boots on! How to use them is in the guide under the Mana Equipment chapter. Go look.

research.koniava.mana_basics.description: Mana flows through all living things. The ancients called it the breath of creation.
research.koniava.mana_flow.description: Mana can be guided through channels. Ancient conduits once carried it across vast distances.
research.koniava.mana_flow.lore: The 'channels' behave less like magic and more like... pipes.
research.koniava.mana_generation.descrip: Combustion releases latent mana. The yield exceeds what the material alone should produce.
research.koniava.mana_generation.lore: Energy in, energy out. Where have I heard that before.
research.koniava.mana_crystallisation.de: Under the right conditions, mana solidifies. The crystal structure is remarkably regular.
research.koniava.mana_infusion.descripti: Infuse mana directly into matter. This is not just enhancement; it is reshaping.
research.koniava.mana_infusion.lore: The resonance of life and mana... this machine is a miracle.
research.koniava.advanced_conduits.descr: The bandwidth of basic conduits has reached its limit. We need more precise and powerful energy transport media.
research.koniava.advanced_conduits.lore: Higher bandwidth, more possibilities. I can almost feel the energy vibrating.
research.koniava.mana_tools.description: Mana crystals can be shaped into tools. The crystal lattice channels mana directly through the blade.
research.koniava.mana_tools.lore: A pickaxe. A wand. Tools built on the same principle: crystal as a conductor.
research.koniava.mana_equipment.descript: Mana alloy is not just a material, it is a vessel. The equipment itself stores mana and releases it when it matters.
research.koniava.mana_equipment.lore: The moment I put it on, I realized: I was not just using mana. I was part of it.

guide.koniava.aspect.intro.title: What Are Aspects?
guide.koniava.aspect.intro.body:
Aspects are the fundamental units that make up the mana in this world, think of them as the chemical elements of magic. Six primary aspects: Water, Fire, Wood, Metal, Earth, and Void, plus 80 compound aspects derived from them.

Scanning objects grants aspect points, which are spent on research (connecting aspect paths in the hex puzzle).
guide.koniava.aspect.scanning.title: How to Scan
guide.koniava.aspect.scanning.body:
Hold the Nara Watch and aim at a block, entity, or item on the ground. Hold right-click for about half a second.

On completion, the chat shows which aspects were found and how many points were gained. Each target can only be scanned once.

Scan range: 4.5 blocks.
guide.koniava.aspect.types.title: Primary Aspect Types
guide.koniava.aspect.types.body:
Water: liquids, fish, cold-related
Fire: fuels, lava, explosions
Wood: plants, wood, living things
Metal: ores, metals, tools
Earth: stone, dirt, terrain
Void: darkness, emptiness, mystery

Different targets yield different aspect combinations.
guide.koniava.research.overview.title: Research Overview
guide.koniava.research.overview.body:
Hold the watch and right-click on air to open the research tree. Nodes have three states:

Available (blue pulse): prerequisites met, click to select, then click again to receive a research note.
Completed (green): unlocked, recipes and features are active.
Locked (gray): missing prereqs or aspect requirements.
guide.koniava.research.table.title: Using the Research Table
guide.koniava.research.table.body:
After getting a research note, craft and place a Research Table. Open it:

Left slot: research note
Right slot: ink quill
Confirm to start the puzzle, connect aspect cells following the connection rules to complete the research.

Completing research unlocks the corresponding crafting recipes.
guide.koniava.research.aspect_synth.body:
Open the Research Table and click the synthesis button to enter the Aspect Synthesis screen. Here you can combine two basic aspects to produce more complex ones.

Drag aspects from the palette into the two input slots on the left. If a valid synthesis exists, the result appears on the right.

Each synthesis consumes ink from the ink quill in the slot. Browse all available combinations via the JEI button in the top area of the screen.
guide.koniava.mana.generator.title: Mana Generator
guide.koniava.mana.generator.body: The Mana Generator is the origin of every mana network. Place it, open the interface, and insert fuel (like a furnace). The machine burns fuel and produces mana, stored in its internal buffer and pushed downstream through conduits.
guide.koniava.mana.conduit.title: Conduit Network
guide.koniava.mana.conduit.body:
Conduits connect generators to machines; mana is pushed automatically upstream to downstream. Three tiers:

Basic: 256 mana/tick
Advanced: 1024 mana/tick (altar crafted)
Elite: 4096 mana/tick (high-tier altar)

Conduits auto-connect when placed adjacent.
guide.koniava.mana.machines.title: Mana Machines
guide.koniava.mana.machines.body:
Machines available once connected to mana:

Mana Grinder: grinds raw materials into processed components
Mana Crafting Table: special crafting using mana
Mana Infuser: infuses items with mana to enhance them
Mana Deployer: automated operations with animation

Each machine requires sufficient mana throughput to operate.

Note: each machine's crafting recipe is locked until you complete the corresponding research tree node.
guide.koniava.mana.grinder.title: Mana Grinder
guide.koniava.mana.grinder.body:
The Mana Grinder processes raw materials into powders and crystals used in advanced mana recipes.

Usage:
1. Connect arcane conduits to supply mana.
2. Place input materials in the input slot.
3. Output accumulates in the output slot automatically.

JEI: open the grinder interface and click the progress bar in the top-right corner to browse all grindable recipes.
guide.koniava.mana.infuser.title: Mana Infuser
guide.koniava.mana.infuser.body:
The Mana Infuser channels mana directly into items, transforming ordinary materials into enhanced versions.

Usage:
1. Connect arcane conduits for mana supply.
2. Place the target item in the input slot.
3. Wait for the progress bar to complete, then collect from the output slot.

JEI: open the infuser and click the progress bar in the top-right to browse all infusion recipes.
guide.koniava.mana.crafting.title: Mana Crafting Table
guide.koniava.mana.crafting.body:
The Mana Crafting Table handles advanced crafting recipes that require a mana supply in addition to materials.

Usage:
1. Connect arcane conduits for mana.
2. Arrange materials in the 3x3 grid.
3. Mana is consumed automatically when the recipe matches.
4. Collect the output from the result slot.

JEI: click near the crafting grid to look up available mana crafting recipes.
guide.koniava.altar.overview.title: Altar Overview
guide.koniava.altar.overview.body:
The altar is the core device for synthesizing high-tier items by consuming mana and materials. It is a multi-block structure of a core, pillars, pedestals, and resonance rings. Check JEI for the 3D multi-block preview.

Six tiers (T1-T6): higher tiers unlock stronger crafts.

Research required: complete the corresponding research tree nodes to unlock altar material recipes for each tier.
guide.koniava.altar.usage.title: Using the Altar
guide.koniava.altar.usage.body:
1. Build the multi-block structure as shown in JEI.
2. Place the catalyst on the center pedestal and ingredients on the surrounding pedestals.
3. Hold a Ritual Wand and right-click the altar core to start the ritual.
4. Keep your conduit network supplying mana for the entire duration.
5. When complete, the result item appears at the center or drops nearby.

If materials are missing or no recipe matches, the wand shows an error message.
guide.koniava.altar.upgrade.title: Upgrading the Altar
guide.koniava.altar.upgrade.body:
Add Resonance Rings to the existing structure to upgrade the altar tier.

T1: minimal structure
T2-T4: progressively more pillars and rings
T5-T6: full surrounding structure required

Upgrading to T5 and T6 triggers a dedicated upgrade animation. T6 is the current maximum tier.
guide.koniava.altar.ritual.title: Ritual and Instability
guide.koniava.altar.ritual.body:
Once a ritual starts, the altar draws mana from connected conduits every tick until the full mana cost is consumed.

If mana supply is interrupted mid-ritual, the altar enters an unstable state:
  - Lightning sparks appear on the core block as a warning
  - You have 10 seconds to restore the mana supply

If not restored in time, the ritual collapses:
  - A red shockwave expands outward
  - Players within 64 blocks lose 50% max HP and receive Slowness II
  - Each item on a pedestal has a 50% chance to scatter, or a 15% chance to vanish permanently

Keep your conduits running for the full duration to avoid failure.
guide.koniava.weapons.overview.title: Floating Turret
guide.koniava.weapons.overview.body:
The Floating Turret is a Tier 2 research unlock, a mana-powered weapon with two operating modes: Hand Mode (active weapon) and Equipment Slot Mode (passive guardian).

It has a built-in mana tank that must be charged manually, and it has durability.
guide.koniava.weapons.hand.title: Hand Mode
guide.koniava.weapons.hand.body:
Hold in your main or off hand. Dual wielding two turrets is supported. Right-click fires a mana bolt that auto-aims toward your crosshair.

While dual wielding, hold right-click to charge: release quickly for simultaneous normal shots from both cannons, or hold until full charge to unleash a combined bolt with damage scaling from charge time.

Normal fire costs a small amount of mana; a full charged release costs a large amount of mana. Both modes consume durability.
guide.koniava.weapons.turret.title: Equipment Slot Mode
guide.koniava.weapons.turret.body:
Install in a TURRET equipment slot (up to 2 slots). The turret becomes an autonomous guardian.

Attacking enemies or taking damage triggers combat state, in which the turret auto-attacks nearby hostile mobs and orbits around you. It despawns after a period without combat.

The turret has its own HP and mobs will target it. When destroyed, the item automatically returns to your inventory.
guide.koniava.weapons.upgrade.title: Upgrade Modules
guide.koniava.equipment.overview.title: Mana Alloy Armor Set
guide.koniava.equipment.overview.body:
A four-piece set: helmet, chestplate, leggings, and boots. Each piece stores mana independently and has upgrade slots.

Craft at the Altar (T1) using the matching iron armor base plus mana materials. Use the Mana Charger to refill mana.

Upgrade slots accept Capacity upgrades (more mana storage) or Armor upgrades (more defense), Mk0 through Mk3, crafted at the Mana Crafting Table.
guide.koniava.equipment.boots.title: Mana Sprint Boots
guide.koniava.equipment.boots.body:
Press the Dash key (default V) to consume mana and sprint forward at high speed. Disabled in water and lava.

Upgrade slots: Dash Distance (longer sprint), Mana Efficiency (lower cost), Capacity (more mana storage), Armor (more defense). Each scales from Mk0 to Mk3.

Open the upgrade interface with the upgrade GUI key (default U) and use the Mana Charger to refill.
guide.koniava.equipment.leggings.title: Mana Alloy Leggings
guide.koniava.equipment.leggings.body:
Press the jump key again while airborne to activate a double jump, consuming 300 mana for an upward boost. Requires a brief pause after leaving the ground to avoid accidental triggers. Disabled in water and lava.

Upgrade slots: Capacity (more mana storage), Armor (more defense).
guide.koniava.equipment.chestplate.title: Mana Alloy Chestplate
guide.koniava.equipment.chestplate.body:
Passive protection only, no active ability. Wearing it directly increases your defense and mana capacity, suited for surviving high-risk situations.

Upgrade slots: Capacity (increases mana cap), Armor (increases defense).
guide.koniava.equipment.helmet.title: Mana Alloy Helmet
guide.koniava.equipment.helmet.body:
While worn, displays two panels in the top-left corner of the screen:

Equipment panel: lists all equipped mana pieces and their current mana levels.

Environment concentration: calculated from the biome base value plus nearby mana machine density. Mana Plains is highest (80%); Nether and End are near zero. Currently display-only, with hooks reserved for future systems.
